title: The KV Wall
description: KV cache size (GiB) vs context length for Llama 3.1 8B, 70B, and 405B on log-log axes, against A10G / H100 VRAM ceilings. Toggle BF16, INT4, or DeltaKV compression and drag the cursor — the panel shows whether the live KV state fits on a single GPU.
controls: drag or click to move the context cursor
arrow keys ← → to step through context lengths
compression tabs toggle BF16 / INT4 / DeltaKV curves
